content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I am building a test rig to measure tensile and shear strength of assemblies and materials. Currently, I have a [product_name] controller and want to use it to regulate the speed of an electric motor with position feedback from a quadrature encoder. Is this achievable? My approach involves interpreting the quadrature signals to generate a speed value and then comparing it to a setpoint to modulate the motor speed accordingly.
Hi [user_name], please review my response under 'motor control' for relevant information. Kind regards, [user_name]

Hello, thank you for your reply. I reviewed your suggestion, but I'm not actively working on the project right now. I'll continue development once the actuator and encoder hardware are delivered. There are many interesting tasks and limited time.
